title: IncidentsResponse
description: Envelope of the trafico incidents command (docs/ARRANQUE.md section 5.3): exactly one JSON value on stdout, always with attribution and publication metadata (P-05, P-08).

query.description: Echo of the filters actually applied, so an agent can verify what it asked for. Documented keys: road (array of normalised road names), pk ({"from", "to"}, only with a single road), status (active|planned|all), and the other filters of section 5.2 (direction, province, type, severity, from, to, limit, sort). Keys the command did not apply are absent.

road.description: Roads requested via --road, in normalised form.

status.description: Status filter requested via --status (active by default).

feed.description: Identifier of the feed the data came from.

published_at.description: Publication time of the feed payload (com:publicationTime), the only valid freshness source (docs/feeds.md section 2). RFC3339 UTC.

fetched_at.description: When trafico downloaded the payload, RFC3339 UTC.

age_seconds.description: Seconds between published_at and the query; null when the feed carries no publication time.

stale.description: True when the data is older than the configured staleness limit: an agent must not present it as "now" (P-08).

from_cache.description: True when the response came from the shared 60-second cache (P-06).

total.description: Number of incidents in this response after filtering.

unlocated.description: Incidents excluded from a --province or --near filter because the record carried no location.

coverage_note.description: Present only when the filter touches provinces with known coverage gaps: it states that the DGT feed excludes the incidents managed by the SCT (Cataluña) and the Basque Government, although a few DGT-managed roads there do appear (docs/feeds.md section 4.6).

meta.description: Freshness and count metadata shared by every response.

incidents.description: The matching incidents, each validating against incident.schema.json.

source.description: Mandatory CC BY attribution of the data source.

attribution.description: Attribution block present in every response (P-05, ARRANQUE section 2.1).
